overview: Every point of forecast error in a Gulf CPG business is paid for twice — once as sales lost to an empty shelf, and again as capital parked in safety stock and eventual markdowns. Demand Forecasting & Demand Sensing builds SKU-store models across shipments, retailer sell-out, promotions, weather and local events, so short-term shifts become visible to planners instead of being absorbed by buffer inventory. The planner keeps the override; the model surfaces the exceptions worth looking at. Redington measures the customer’s own forecast error before any build starts, then proves lower error, fewer stockouts and released working capital on their data, in their own tenancy, across a four-to-five week MVP.
